notes: «تابعه إسماعيل عن مالك» is a mutabaʿa: a variant group, not a route; the rest of the chain is not repeated
«وقال روح عن مالك رابح» names another transmitter under Malik with a different word («رابح» for «رائح»): a variant group
«قرأت على مالك» is a reading to the teacher; Malik stands as the shaykh of Ishaq's chain
